rca of the issue: ProfileSettings.jsx line 224 references <Image/> JSX element. The lucide-react import block (lines 12-16) does NOT include 'Image'. With no in-scope Image identifier, JSX resolves to the global window.Image (HTMLImageElement constructor). React then tries to call it as a function component which throws 'Failed to construct Image: Please use the new operator'. The crash is fatal because the error is thrown during render of the Profile tab, blocking all settings UI. Fix: per the iteration spec the entire Profile Logo URL block should be deleted and replaced with the new pixel avatar block (PixelAvatar component is already imported on line 19 but never rendered in the Profile tab). Reproduction: visit /settings with userId set.
